response.rationale: The item is apparel (not electronics), final_sale is null/not True, and days_since_delivery is 10 (<= 30). RET-007 applies for eligibility. Higher-priority rules do not apply: RET-012 requires final_sale == True (it is null), RET-020 requires defective == True (it is null), and RET-050/RET-051 require goodwill_grant/fraud_hold flags which are false.
